column1: # MagicBox fleet — single source of truth.
# One row per box. Columns are TAB-separated.
#   num         Box number (drives the public hostnames box-N / ssh-box-N).
#   tunnel_id   Cloudflare Tunnel UUID for that box (public; also the DNS
#               the credentials JSON it references stays on the box only.
#   api_host    Box LAN IP where the VMOS/cbs_go API listens (:18182). Written
#               to /etc/magicbox-proxy.env by deploy.sh as an explicit override,
#               because these hosts have several non-internal IPv4s (docker0
#               172.17.0.1, gateway alias, …) and the proxy's auto-detect could
#               otherwise pick the wrong one. Leave empty to fall back to
# Per-box config is rendered from this file by scripts/deploy.sh. Everything
# else (proxy code, systemd units, ingress shape) is identical across boxes.
